note: Unbaked. Dialogue lines in scene order (opening, retry, aftermath, globe narration). Vance has no voice yet (needs a new cast entry before baking), Marlowe speaks in his chapter 12 voice, Sal in his usual voice, everyone else uses their existing voices. Nara never speaks, so her narration line is left out. No battle lines were added (no kind route).

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The Square, the morning after the dinner. Six of us, two grandparents, and one very big camera on a tripod.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I wore the good scrunchie. I want that on the record.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I wore my ALSO scrunchie.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Nobody touches anything. Hands to yourselves. If it looks like a trap, it is a trap.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Is that the photographer? He looks like he hasn’t eaten. Robert, look how thin he is.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: A grown man in a grey suit on a Tuesday. That’s the whole problem right there.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Wonderful. Everybody came. I love a turnout.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Marlowe. Monochrome Marlowe. We met in Jefferson Park. I took the pink out of your neighbor’s window. I’d say sorry, but honestly I think it looks better.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Where is he?

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Mr. Vance is in a meeting. He sends his regards, and a camera.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It’s a very big camera.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: It’s looking at me.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: That’s what cameras do. Little ones in front, please. Tall ones in back. Everybody tight. Mr. Vance likes everybody tight.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I took a portrait class once. This is a terrible setup. The light is coming from inside the camera.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Is it going to take long? I have a roast in. Robert. Stand up straight.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: I AM standing up straight. This is as straight as I go.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Marlowe. What is the photograph for?

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Mr. Vance keeps the happy ones. A good family at the right moment, just so. Nothing ever changes again. Nobody leaves. It’s a gift.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Nobody asked for the gift.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We said we’d bring everyone. We didn’t say we’d stay.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Everybody stays in a photograph. That’s what a photograph is.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Hello, Tom. Thank you for flying nowhere. I have waited a very long time for a picture where nobody leaves.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: That’s the voice. That’s the fella with the deal.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Hello, Robert. You broke our contract. That’s all right. I am a forgiving man. Everybody, please look here.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I’m doing my photo face.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I’m doing my ALSO face.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Amy.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I know. Girls, down. Behind me. NOW.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Not Tom. Not the grown ones. The little ones. The ones with all their years still in them. Those are the ones I want to keep.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Robert.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Girls. Close your eyes. Moon and back.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Nobody gets past us.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Mom! Dad!

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Fifty-one years.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: ...And counting.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Deedee?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Boppy. You can move now.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Mom.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nobody moves. Nobody says anything. In the middle of the Square two stone figures hold each other up, and a small amber light crawls along their joined hands.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: There. That is a family photograph. Thank you, Tom. You may keep the frame.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Where are you?

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Marlowe. Collect the children.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Mr. Vance. They are... they are children. I only moved the colors around. That’s all I ever did. I never wrote anything like that.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Then I shall help with your notes.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Less. Less. Less. That is all I ever wanted. Less.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Grace. Rose. Go. Cab seven. Find Sal. Now.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: But Deedee...

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I know. Go. Please, Grace.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Rose. Hand. Run. Now.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: But Boppy...

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I KNOW. RUN.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Tom. Whatever this is, it is between them and the road.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Then it doesn’t get past us. Dad said so.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I’m here, babe.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: Less. Round two.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Slow down. Break the eclipse and heal after the flash. Together.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Up. Up. We are not done. Breathe. Then we go again.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The amber goes out of him all at once. Nobody cheers. There is no song. There is only the wind going through the Square.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: I wanted it quieter. I only ever wanted it quieter.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Look at them. LOOK.

lines.speaker: Marlowe
lines.text: I didn’t want it like this.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nobody does. That is what he counts on.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Mom. Dad.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It’s warm. Amy. It’s still a little warm.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Then they’re not gone.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: They’re not gone.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Then we get them back.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Thank you for the photograph. It is perfect. I would like to keep it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Give them back.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Nobody leaves, Tom. That is what a photograph is for. If you want them, you know the building. Downtown. Sixty floors. Do come up. I will leave the light on.

lines.speaker: Sal
lines.text: TOMMY! The glass is coming down! I have the girls in the cab! GET IN!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Amy. TNB. Nara. Run.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Dad. Keep her warm. I’m coming back.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Sal took the Sub-Rail the long way, with the meter off. Nobody has said anything since the tunnel.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Tata. Are they cold?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: No, Rose. They’re warm. I checked.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Then it’s not forever. It’s just a long time.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It’s just a long time.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Vance said downtown. Sixty floors. We rest tonight. Tomorrow we go up.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We got out. Sal went through the closing glass with the meter running, and it shaved the roof off cab seven.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Behind us the glass closes. Long Island is the size of a snow globe now, and a cable is taking it up into the sky.
